name: Cerebras
how_you_get_it: Add a card to a Cerebras account. The credit only appears after the card does.
trap: The widely-repeated 1 million tokens a day is a RATE LIMIT, not a free grant. Aggregator sites re-render it as free tokens. The only money here is $5, it needs a card, and it dies in 30 days.
